entities.summary: Cold War Ethnic Split and Independence, a transformative movement in Guyana (1950–1966). Emerged from Labour Unrest and Political Awakening. Catalyzed PPP wins 1953 election — British suspend constitution after 133 days and CIA/MI6 covertly engineer PPP split along ethnic lines — 1955.
